description: Requirements audit submit payload. Judge each in-scope product requirement with evidence.

requirementID.description: Stable id of the product requirement from the brief/ledger.

verdict.description: Whether the product currently satisfies this requirement.

evidence.description: Citations: file paths, command output summaries, or observed behavior.

proposedCriteria.description: Optional shell commands that can re-check this requirement later. Use empty array when none.

summary.description: One to three sentences summarizing overall requirements status.
